import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int INF = 1000000009;
    static int n, m, deadline;
    static char[][] sci, rea;
    static int[][] danger;
    static ArrayList<ArrayList<Integer>> G;
    static ArrayList<Edge> E;
    static int[] level, nextEdge;
    static int src, sink;

    static class Edge {
        int u, v, flow, capacity;
        Edge(int u, int v, int flow, int capacity) {
            this.u = u;
            this.v = v;
            this.flow = flow;
            this.capacity = capacity;
        }
    }

    static void addEdge(int u, int v, int c) {
        G.get(u).add(E.size());
        E.add(new Edge(u, v, 0, c));
        G.get(v).add(E.size());
        E.add(new Edge(v, u, 0, 0));
    }

    static boolean findLevel() {
        Arrays.fill(level, -1);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        level[src] = 0;
        q.add(src);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            for (int id : G.get(u)) {
                int v = E.get(id).v;
                if (level[v] == -1 && E.get(id).flow < E.get(id).capacity) {
                    level[v] = level[u] + 1;
                    q.add(v);
                    if (v == sink) return true;
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    static long blockFlow(int u, int f) {
        if (f == 0) return 0;
        if (u == sink) return f;
        for (int i = nextEdge[u]; i < G.get(u).size(); ++i) {
            int id = G.get(u).get(i);
            int v = E.get(id).v;
            if (level[v] != level[u] + 1) continue;
            long pushed = blockFlow(v, Math.min(f, E.get(id).capacity - E.get(id).flow));
            if (pushed > 0) {
                E.get(id).flow += (int)pushed;
                E.get(id ^ 1).flow -= (int)pushed;
                return pushed;
            }
            nextEdge[u] = i + 1;
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static long dinic() {
        long ans = 0;
        while (findLevel()) {
            Arrays.fill(nextEdge, 0);
            long pushed;
            while ((pushed = blockFlow(src, INF)) > 0) {
                ans += pushed;
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }

    static boolean valid(int r, int c) {
        return r >= 0 && c >= 0 && r < n && c < m;
    }

    static int getID(int x, int y) {
        return 1 + m * x + y;
    }

    static boolean canReach(int sx, int sy, int tx, int ty) {
        boolean[][] seen = new boolean[n][m];
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(new int[]{sx, sy, 1});
        seen[sx][sy] = true;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.poll();
            int x = cur[0], y = cur[1], tim = cur[2];
            if (x == tx && y == ty) {
                seen[tx][ty] = true;
                break;
            }
            if (tim >= danger[x][y] || tim >= deadline) continue;
            for (int dx = -1; dx <= 1; ++dx) {
                for (int dy = -1; dy <= 1; ++dy) {
                    if (Math.abs(dx) + Math.abs(dy) != 1) continue;
                    int nx = x + dx, ny = y + dy;
                    if (valid(nx, ny) && !seen[nx][ny] &&
                        sci[nx][ny] != 'Y' && sci[nx][ny] != 'Z' &&
                        tim + 1 <= danger[nx][ny]) {
                        seen[nx][ny] = true;
                        q.add(new int[]{nx, ny, tim + 1});
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return seen[tx][ty];
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        deadline = sc.nextInt();
        ++deadline;
        m = n;

        sci = new char[n][m];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            String s = sc.next();
            sci[i] = s.toCharArray();
        }

        danger = new int[n][m];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) Arrays.fill(danger[i], INF);
        Queue<int[]> q0 = new LinkedList<>();
        rea = new char[n][m];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            String s = sc.next();
            rea[i] = s.toCharArray();
            for (int j = 0; j < m; ++j) {
                if (rea[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    q0.add(new int[]{i, j});
                    danger[i][j] = 1;
                }
            }
        }

        while (!q0.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q0.poll();
            int x = cur[0], y = cur[1];
            for (int dx = -1; dx <= 1; ++dx) {
                for (int dy = -1; dy <= 1; ++dy) {
                    if (Math.abs(dx) + Math.abs(dy) != 1) continue;
                    int nx = x + dx, ny = y + dy;
                    if (valid(nx, ny) && danger[nx][ny] == INF && sci[nx][ny] != 'Y') {
                        danger[nx][ny] = danger[x][y] + 1;
                        q0.add(new int[]{nx, ny});
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        src = 0;
        sink = n * n + n * n + 1;
        int nodeCount = n * n * 2 + 2;
        G = new ArrayList<>(nodeCount);
        for (int i = 0; i < nodeCount; ++i) G.add(new ArrayList<>());
        E = new ArrayList<>();
        level = new int[nodeCount];
        nextEdge = new int[nodeCount];

        for (int x = 0; x < n; ++x) {
            for (int y = 0; y < m; ++y) {
                if (sci[x][y] >= '1' && sci[x][y] <= '9')
                    addEdge(src, getID(x, y), sci[x][y] - '0');
                if (rea[x][y] >= '1' && rea[x][y] <= '9')
                    addEdge(n * n + getID(x, y), sink, rea[x][y] - '0');

                for (int X = 0; X < n; ++X) {
                    for (int Y = 0; Y < m; ++Y) {
                        if (sci[x][y] == 'Y' || sci[x][y] == 'Z' || rea[X][Y] == 'Y' || rea[X][Y] == 'Z')
                            continue;
                        if (canReach(x, y, X, Y))
                            addEdge(getID(x, y), n * n + getID(X, Y), INF);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(dinic());
        sc.close();
    }
}
